title: Source-described scholarly composite
description: A modern reconstruction, collation or arrangement, not its ancient referent, a physical member, publication, exact text layer or admitted reading. Native composite-witness v1 records retain their unchanged adapter and identities.

composition_account.description: What this scholarly composition reconstructs, collates or arranges, with attribution and uncertainty. Exact membership is separately grounded.

editorial_method.description: Reported editorial operations and their limits; not a replayable extraction event or approval of readings.

coverage_account.description: Reported extent, omissions and limits; a complete-looking presentation does not prove completeness of an ancient work or its surviving witnesses.
